what: Standalone review batch registration is incomplete
scenario_or_breakage: The plan only adds review-findings-classification to log-phase, but larch-log.sh resolves batch paths through larch-log-batches.sh and will fail unknown batch
suggested_fix: Add review-findings-classification .tsv replace none to scripts/larch-log-batches.sh, update scripts/larch-log-batches.md and scripts/test-larch-logs-batches.sh including .tsv extension support

what: Missing voter columns cannot be mapped to stable v1 v2 v3 slots
scenario_or_breakage: review-core collapses successful voter files before tally, so a missing middle slot makes v2 columns refer to voter 3 instead of remaining empty
suggested_fix: Pass three explicit voter slot records or a slot manifest into tally-code-votes.sh and write columns by slot number, with a test where voter 2 is missing and voter 3 is present

what: OOS_N ballots are not covered by parse-rate retry
scenario_or_breakage: The plan asks voters to handle OOS_N, but parse-rate counting still scans only FINDING_N headings, so OOS-only or omitted-OOS ballots can pass without retry and become JUDGE_ERROR rows
suggested_fix: Update parse-rate id extraction and retry wording to include both FINDING_N and OOS_N, and add an OOS_N omission/retry harness case

what: reviewer_slots and voting_result semantics are underspecified for code review
scenario_or_breakage: The names come from other review artifacts and can mean proposer reviewers, voter judges, JSON arrays, accepted/rejected outcomes, or OOS filing disposition
suggested_fix: Define reviewer_slots as the originating ballot Reviewer(s) attribution and define voting_result as the classify_result enum accepted rejected neutral exonerated for both FINDING_N and OOS_N, then mirror that wording in docs/run-logs.md

what: Zero-finding header-only invariant is not fully wired or tested
scenario_or_breakage: The plan states a header row is emitted for empty ballots, but its fixtures do not cover that case and review-core zero-findings exits before the generic TSV KV pass-through
suggested_fix: Add a zero-findings fixture asserting exactly the header, re-emit FINDINGS_CLASSIFICATION_TSV_FILE in the zero-findings branch, and document header-only files in docs/run-logs.md

scenario_or_breakage: One section says missing or unrecognized ratings become empty with UNCERTAIN=true, while another says out-of-enum values are recorded verbatim
suggested_fix: Choose one policy and state it once in the tally writer, voter prompt docs, and tests; if raw values are kept, update the lenient-policy line to exclude unrecognized tokens
